name: Hazuki Tsubame
source:
Birth year: 1990

Protagonist of "Story 1 - Bottomless cave"

A girl who spent the summer break with her family at her grandparent's house. When [url=/c88250]Hayato[/url] invites her to go inside the jungle, she agrees to go out of boredom and curiosity.

Protagonist of "Story 2 - School, a close friend and me"

A year has passed by. It's the last semester before the beginning of summer break. Despite being hesitant because of what happened in the forest a year ago, she still came to take the test of courage, following the [url=/c92079]School Committee President[/url]'s proposal.

Main character of "Story 3 - Crimson hair"

[spoiler]Main character of "Story 4 - Shimaigusa"

After her death one year ago, Tsubame remains as an onnen-rei (怨念霊 - a grudge-originated ghost) in this world until now. Every night without changes, she would go seek revenge to those people who have pushed her into this situation.[/spoiler]
